title: Asset-Class Scoreboard
headline_read: How the major asset classes are moving right now.

indicators.title: S&P 500
indicators.context: The benchmark index of 500 large U.S. companies — the headline gauge of U.S. stocks.
indicators.read: The S&P 500 is up 13% over the past year, now 6,100.00.

indicators.title: Crude Oil · WTI
indicators.context: West Texas Intermediate, the U.S. benchmark oil price (dollars per barrel) — a read on energy costs and global demand.
indicators.read: WTI crude is down 6% over the past year, now 68.30.

indicators.title: Gold
indicators.context: Gold (dollars per troy ounce) — the classic safe-haven asset investors flee to in times of stress. Sourced from Yahoo Finance (COMEX futures).
indicators.read: Gold is up 15% over the past year, now 2,710.00.

indicators.title: U.S. Dollar · Broad Index
indicators.context: The trade-weighted value of the U.S. dollar against a broad basket of currencies — a strong dollar makes imports cheaper and U.S. exports pricier.
indicators.read: The dollar index is little changed over the past year, now 119.10.

indicators.title: Bitcoin
indicators.context: The price of Bitcoin in U.S. dollars (Coinbase) — the largest cryptocurrency and a barometer of risk appetite in digital assets.
indicators.read: Bitcoin is up 25% over the past year, now 65,000.00.

indicators.title: Ethereum
indicators.context: The price of Ether in U.S. dollars (Coinbase) — the second-largest cryptocurrency and the backbone of most decentralized applications.
indicators.read: Ethereum is up 11% over the past year, now 3,100.00.
